method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 乘火车望向窗外，列车快到 Boston。
facts.anchor: Hattie watches the landscape scroll by the train’s windows.

facts.fact: Hattie 研究完档案最后一个名字 Elle Marks 后，自认想通了 Bedfellow 的失误所在。
facts.anchor: After researching Elle Marks, the final name in the file with no other information attached to it, she thinks she knows what the Bedfellow’s mistake was.

facts.fact: Hattie 对 Ramsby 本应寄给 Eeling 的照片找不到任何踪迹。
facts.anchor: but she couldn’t find any trace of them.

facts.fact: Hattie 反复想着 Eeling 最后一晚的备忘录；得知 Dustin 曾威胁他，一切有了新解读。
facts.anchor: Knowing now that Dustin threatened him adds a whole new aspect to everything.

facts.fact: Hattie 认为 Eeling 听上去不像要结束生命，倒像是重新开始。
facts.anchor: he didn’t sound like a man on the verge of ending his life. He sounded like one starting anew.

facts.fact: 感恩节成了短暂而受欢迎的喘息：Hattie 白天多数时间与 Crawfords 一家度过，晚上去 Sloan 及儿子 Adam 处吃馅饼。
facts.anchor: Thanksgiving itself had been a brief but very welcome respite.

facts.fact: Wendy 告诉 Hattie 诉讼已被撤销。
facts.anchor: The lawsuit’s been dropped! Or I guess it never really got going.

facts.fact: Kevin 边切火鸡边说 Julian 的智商处于同龄人第九十百分位，因缺乏挑战而积怨。
facts.anchor: His IQ is in the ninetieth percentile for his age, Kevin said as he cut the turkey.

facts.fact: Hattie 到站下车，看见 Leah、Dustin、Colm 三人一起来接她，心中想着其中一人可能是陷害者或凶手。
facts.anchor: One of you could be my son’s betrayer. One of you could be a killer.
